supplementaryReferences.title: Estate cultivar identity and processing basis
supplementaryReferences.quote: There are 3 varieties that have been planted and harvested at Beaver Creek.
supplementaryReferences.doc: Beaver Creek Coffee Estate, Coffee Cultivars (own-farm observations)
supplementaryReferences.note: The three are SL28, Catuai and F6. The estate explains pulping, fermentation, drying, hulling and roasting after picking; cherry weight, green beans and roasted output are separate products.

supplementaryReferences.title: Local coffee planting context
supplementaryReferences.quote: Beaver Creek Estate, Izingolweni Road, Port Edward, 4295
supplementaryReferences.note: The estate is on the KZN south coast and reports growing SL28, Catuai and F6. This is first-party cultivation evidence, not nationwide suitability.

care: Record coffee-cherry picking separately from drying, hulling and roasting. Do not use roasted packet stock months as the fresh harvest calendar.
Use the Port Edward reference only after checking the actual site's conditions and chosen cultivar.
purchase: SL28, Catuai and F6 are documented on a working Port Edward estate. Ask a local nursery or coffee adviser which planting material fits the site and intended processing.
